desc: Ideation complete: reduce each query to maximum bottleneck connectivity M(u,v) and answer formula.
Implement fast integer input and flatten the grid; generate right/down adjacency edges packed as (weight, u, v).
Sort edges by decreasing weight and build a Kruskal reconstruction tree with DSU.
Compute depths and binary lifting tables for LCA on the reconstruction tree.
Answer queries by computing M via LCA value, applying abs(Y-Z) or Y+Z-2M, and printing results.
Validate edge cases: 1x1 grid, same block queries, equal floors, low bottlenecks, and maximum input sizes.
